dataset_sources.name: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database
dataset_sources.license: Public Domain / Free for any purpose
dataset_sources.access_restrictions: None. Freely downloadable directly from Carnegie Mellon University.
dataset_sources.processing_pipeline: Parsed into standard BVH hierarchical skeleton, converted to canonical 21-joint representation, normalized to 30 FPS and 1.75m reference height.
dataset_sources.notes: Widely cited open benchmark dataset containing diverse locomotion, athletic actions, and everyday gestures.

dataset_sources.name: HDM05 Motion Capture Database
dataset_sources.license: Academic / Non-commercial Research License (MPI Informatik & University of Bonn)
dataset_sources.processing_pipeline: Filtered for clean locomotion sequences, resampled to canonical frame rate.
dataset_sources.notes: High-density optical motion capture data recorded with Vicon system.

dataset_sources.name: SFU Motion Capture Database
dataset_sources.processing_pipeline: Extracted joint angle trajectories and converted to world coordinates.
dataset_sources.notes: Curated by Simon Fraser University School of Interactive Arts and Technology.

dataset_sources.name: PoseGuard Biomechanical Gait Generator (Procedural Reference)
dataset_sources.access_restrictions: None. Locally generated from biomechanical gait kinematic models (Winter, 2009).
dataset_sources.processing_pipeline: Synthesizes mathematically clean, ground-truth verified 3D skeletal walk, run, jump, and pivot sequences with zero geometric defects.
dataset_sources.notes: Used as the pristine ground-truth baseline for controlled synthetic defect injection and benchmark validation.
